records.subject: Getting started with Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Kai,

Thanks for setting up Quartz Ventures on Wrenfield. If your team is more than one person, inviting them now tends to pay off -- Wrenfield is built around teammates working on shared tasks, not solo lists.

Let me know how the first week goes.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

decisions.rationale: Kai replied engaged and said setup is "on our list this week" [email:1279900a], a positive signal on a paid Team plan with no tickets. But at day 6 there is still no project, no invite, and no milestone, and the stated slowness in getting everyone set up [email:1279900a] cuts against reaching it unaided in 8 days.

draft.subject: Re: Quick check-in from Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Kai,

Thanks for the update — totally understand that getting everyone set up takes a week or two. When you're ready, the in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, and projects are the main organizing unit with tasks inside them. Teammates can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and you can bulk-invite from a CSV file instead of one at a time if that's easier for a larger group.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through your first project and invites with you so nothing stalls on your side.

Best,
Chidi
